notes.author: agent:claude
notes.text: Admin-channel recommendation pending owner confirmation: a Unix domain socket in the 0700 app data directory with 0600 permissions, as used by Docker, tailscaled and containerd. Stage 1 stores only the token verifier, so the CLI can no longer read the raw secret from a 0600 service-access file and call loopback HTTP as it does today. OS file permissions become the authority. Linux and macOS are the supported platforms; Windows is out of scope.

notes.author: agent:codex
notes.text: Reconciled against main 17d0c9d7e5be6d3f451298cdb7b364dbf25f5200 and successful CI https://github.com/pioootrek/worktree-switcher/actions/runs/36312411574. Stage 1 A–F and review fixes are merged in PR #54: persisted policy, open/token transport authentication, default token mode, migration, browser login, token rotation and online Unix-socket administration. Do not reimplement these. Source review found remaining credential-free CLI gaps: runKnowledgeCommand, runHubImportExecuteCommand, identity administratorToken and logical backup export/import require a token before applying open-mode policy. CI success does not cover this missing acceptance case. Keep this item open for these paths and their focused transport tests; Better Auth is separate.

problem: Global authentication modes are implemented on main, but knowledge CLI, identity administration and logical export/import still reject absent token environment variables before applying open-mode policy. This contradicts the agreed credential-free open-mode workflow.

risk.rollback: Preserve data and historical identities. Reject an invalid target mode before changing the active policy. Recover through local CLI into token mode with a newly emitted credential; never silently fall back to open or stop managed processes to repair authentication.

scope: Preserve delivered stage 1 behavior: persisted open/token/legacy policy, default token mode, verifier-only tokens, shared browser login, Unix-socket mode administration, rotation and session invalidation.

Make online knowledge CLI and online/offline identity-administration commands honor open mode without requiring a token environment variable. Preserve strict token/scoped-credential validation in protected modes, safe endpoint discovery and singleton ownership.

Apply open-mode installation authority to offline Hub execute-import and logical backup export/import without requiring a dummy credential. Preserve the singleton lock and record anonymous authority honestly.
Keep Better Auth implementation, runtime-scoped delegation and convenience routing of other CLI operations through the admin socket outside this residual fix.
source: Owner authentication roadmap decision on 2026-09-17; supersedes independent Web/MCP switches
title: Complete credential-free knowledge and administration CLI flows in open mode
trigger: Owner requested this as authentication roadmap stage 1 on 2026-09-17; stage 2 Better Auth depends on its shared provider boundary.
validation: With all WORKTREE_SWITCHER_*TOKEN variables absent, verify online knowledge reads/writes and identity administration against a real open-mode controller, plus offline identity administration, Hub import and logical project export/import under the singleton lock.
Verify the same commands reject missing, invalid and revoked credentials in protected modes, scoped tokens retain their grants, and open-mode history records authenticationMethod none.

Run focused CLI/transport regressions and the supported check/build and packaged verification affected by the fix. Reuse main CI 36312411574 as evidence for delivered stage 1, not as proof of the missing open-mode CLI cases.
value: One explicit installation policy removes repeated knowledge authentication and keeps a complete MIT self-hosted edition while establishing the optional provider boundary.
